g.text: D3 - Normal WAL-enabled write path; fixed and variable records
RequestFlush(): wait unless flush already queued
No background writer: FlushToWAL in caller.
Flush errors are logged, not returned by RequestFlush.
MID TGDATA + TG length + TG + MD5
(overwrite slot; page cache, no fsync here)
read old payload, merge + timestamp sort,
optional Snappy, write tail + 24-byte indirect slot
async; even after logged primary-write errors
every wal_rotate_interval timer events: truncate WAL
